name: Anco Equipment
old_description: I have been in the food & dairy processing equipment industry for over 17 years and founded Anco Equipment almost 13 years ago. I take pride seeing my customers business grow using my equipment. When I am not working you can find me at the golf course, in the woods, or hanging out with my wife on our hobby farm.
about:
Anco Equipment is based in Pulaski, Wisconsin. The company was founded by Trevor Anderson, who brought 17 years of experience in the food and dairy processing equipment industry, approximately 13 years ago. His wife, Rebecca Anderson, joined as co-owner, having grown up in the dairy equipment business through her father, Fran Ullmer.

Anco Equipment designs and manufactures stainless steel processing equipment, including mixing tanks, pasteurizers, homogenizers, cheese vats, butter churns, milk silos, and clean-out-of-place wash tanks. The equipment is built from 304 and 316 stainless steel for heating, cooling, storing, mixing, and aging products. The company collaborates with experienced engineers to provide start-to-finish solutions.

The company serves the food, dairy, beverage, cosmetic, and chemical processing industries. Its customer base includes major brands such as Coca-Cola, Starbucks, Unilever, Godiva Chocolate, and McDonald's.

Anderson founded the company to provide high-quality, detail-oriented equipment that helps customers grow their businesses. Anco emphasizes a pragmatic approach, safety compliance, and start-to-finish engineering support.
